entries.signature: fn resolve_tool_fallback( _name: &str, allow_fallback: bool, ) -> Result<Option<RuntimeToolLease>, String>
inputs: Borrowed tool name and explicit fallback permission; the underscore-prefixed binding remains semantically live in debug builds.
sideEffects: No filesystem access; cfg(test) increments the successful-resolution counter when the debug fallback is returned.
errors: No current error branch despite the Result return type.
ownership: A debug Some result owns a PathBuf derived from _name and contains no File or cache guard.
invariants: allow_fallback=false returns None in every profile.
Only debug_assertions builds may resolve the supplied tool name through development PATH fallback; release builds always return None and cannot execute an unverified PATH tool.
tests: runtime::tests::verified_runtime_cache_waits_for_leases_and_blocks_reacquisition exercises resolve_tool_lease_from_cache with fallback disabled and a verified cache lease.
runtime::tests::explicit_root_runtime_harness_reuses_leases_and_refreshes exercises the same resolver boundary with fallback disabled through the explicit-root harness.
The debug PATH-fallback and release refusal branches are compile-time cfg behavior and have no focused direct runtime test; the identifier-only correction required no new focused test.
